text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While having lunch in the cafeteria, I spotted Symboli Kris S walking with a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To think you would invite me to lunch. It might not be earth-shattering... but I was certainly surprised.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, what is this important matter you wished to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Mission Accomplished.
This is—my report.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A report...? Er... Pardon me, but regarding what?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A mission—was assigned to me.
...Shortly after—I arrived at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have transferred here, after all. There will likely be various hardships.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Until you get used to it, try observing the other students' interactions up close and experiencing them firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And someday, I would like you to tell me how Tracen Academy looks through your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah... My apologies, that is a bad habit of mine. I tend to make everything sound far too formal...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That was not a mission assignment, Kris S. If anything, it was merely advice—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, what is done is done. I shall make no excuses.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So... what are your thoughts? How did it look to you? This Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: An interesting academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Freely...
Playing and laughing with friends—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand—passion for running—
Coexists—in the exact same space.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Wholeheartedly pursuing dreams.
Elevating one another—with friends and rivals...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, interesting.
I have concluded—that it is intriguing... and interesting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see... So that is how it appeared to you. ...It seems you have completely acclimated to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—No... That is...
...difficult. ...Difficult.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—To assimilate means to become one with it.
Academy equal Me... has not—
Ah, there you are!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm doing a new magic trick after this! Won't you come watch again?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood... However... order of arrival.
After this—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Her appearance in Act 3 of the play, 'Return of the Supreme Overlord', has already been decided!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Such is the situation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I see~ What a shame. Then please come watch right after that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Kita-san, Dia, and Cheval too! Everyone is waiting for you♪
Oh! If it isn't Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your help earlier! If it weren't for you, I would've lost track of C.B. again!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Can I call on you again if something comes up?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...No problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Difficult, is it?
...Though it seems only a matter of time.
